snippet.title: Snacktorio - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the grand opening of Snacktorio!
The kitchen is fired up, the machines are running, and the beasts are hungry.

Snacktorio is a story-driven factory-cooking automation game where you build giant industrial kitchens to feed the monsters threatening to consume the world. Ingredients follow real cooking rules: food spoils, contamination spreads, and one bad decision can ripple through an entire factory. 

Design and optimize production lines, turn recipes into scalable food systems, and keep up with increasingly demanding monster orders. Snacktorio mixes deep automation gameplay with a clever fantasy world where keeping dinner running keeps the world alive.

Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902940/Snacktorio/

Genre: Factory automation
Platform: PC
Release Date: June 4th, 2026
